verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a Linux desktop distribution with default AI agents, so an isolated place to test changes is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only adjacent mechanisms. Automatic and manual system snapshots (omarchy-snapshot create) let you roll back changes an agent makes. A Docker-based Windows VM has no access to other files on the system. And all of Omarchy can be run inside a virtual machine to try it first. None of these is documented as a sandbox for agent testing that is kept apart from real data. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or isolated environment for agent and dev testing, documented separation of test data from real user data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
